en.headline: Man found dead in the water off Tai Po Waterfront Park
en.dek: Police said a man in his twenties was recovered near Tai Po Waterfront Park around 7:30am on Tuesday and was confirmed dead. Identity and circumstances are under investigation.
body: Police said a man was found in the water off Tai Po Waterfront Park on Tuesday morning and was confirmed dead after being brought ashore.

Officers received a report at about 7:30am that a person was in the sea near the park, opposite Tai King Street, close to the pier. Firefighters recovered a man described as being in his twenties. He was certified dead at the scene, police said. His identity had not been confirmed.
Police said they were investigating the circumstances. They did not say how he entered the water, and they did not suggest a cause.
People in distress can contact the Shall We Talk mental-health support line on 18111, or the Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong on 2389 2222.

zh.headline: 大埔海濱公園對開海面發現男子 證實死亡
zh.dek: 警方說星期二約早上7時半接報，大埔海濱公園對開有人在海中，救起一名20多歲男子後證實不治，身份及經過仍在調查。
body: 警方表示，星期二早上在大埔海濱公園對開海面發現一名男子，救起後證實死亡。
據警方及現場報道，約早上7時半接獲途人報案，大景街對開、近碼頭的海面有人在水中。消防人員將一名約20多歲男子救起，經檢驗後證實當場死亡。身份仍未確定。
警方說正調查事件經過，暫未說明男子如何落水，亦未指出原因。
情緒受困的人士可致電「情緒通」精神健康支援熱線18111，或香港撒瑪利亞防止自殺會2389 2222。
